target_subject: Yoshitaka Amano watercolor JRPG illustration style
note: WebSearch was unavailable during this session. URLs are based on well-established, known-real sources. In a live session, each would be verified and image URLs extracted via WebFetch.

sources.description: Final Fantasy Wiki comprehensive gallery of Amano's official artwork across all FF titles. High-res scans of character portraits, key visuals, and promotional art.
sources.notes: Focus on FF I-VI entries for classic watercolor period. Skip FF VII+ where Nomura took over character design.

sources.description: Yoshitaka Amano's official portfolio website. Curated selection of his work across games, fine art, and commercial illustration.
sources.notes: Highest authenticity. Filter for watercolor/mixed-media pieces; skip pure fine art abstractions.

sources.description: Art book scans from 'The Sky: The Art of Final Fantasy' 3-volume collection. Full-page high-resolution reproductions covering FF I through X.
sources.notes: Best single source for consistent quality. Curate heavily to the best 15-20 watercolor pieces.

sources.description: Amano's Vampire Hunter D illustrations. Same watercolor technique applied to gothic horror subjects, adding subject diversity.
sources.notes: Include 3-5 pieces to help the LoRA generalize style beyond FF characters.

sources.description: ArtStation search for Amano official artwork. Some users post high-res art book scans and official promotional pieces.
sources.notes: Must carefully filter out fan art, tributes, and Amano-inspired work. Only use confirmed official pieces.

sources.description: Danbooru tagged archive filtered to official Amano art with quality score threshold. Well-organized with consistent tagging.
sources.notes: Good for finding pieces missing from the wiki galleries. Filter by high score for quality scans.

sources.description: Pinterest collections of Amano FF watercolors. Images often downscaled; use as discovery tool to find higher-res versions elsewhere.
sources.notes: Use for discovering pieces, then locate full-resolution versions from Tier A sources.

sources.description: YouTube art showcase compilations featuring Amano's FF artwork with zooms and pans. Good for capturing detail shots.
sources.notes: Use extract_frames.py at 3-5s intervals. Many frames will be transitions or duplicates.

sources.description: Rare process/timelapse videos of Amano painting. Only the final frames of each are useful for training.
sources.notes: Use extract_frames.py with long interval (10-15s). Low priority source.
